sana: Quick Q partner OrionSoft wants hosted + download SKUs. Legal asked for a short public blurb confirming redistribution permissions and a link to the full addenda. Can we ship a one-liner for the marketplace UI?

max: One-liner suggestion: "Available as hosted API or partner-delivered download; redistribution permitted to verified partners under the Redistribution Addendum." Keep a "Learn more" link to the addendum.

sana: Nice. Ops: do we expose two SKUs or a single SKU with fulfillment options? Concern is billing + entitlements.

jules: Please do separate SKUs (hosted, download). Much simpler for metering, rate limits, and bundling with SI services.

max: Heads-up from legal: downloads/derivatives require provenance metadata. Marketplace manifest must include: artifact_checksum, origin_url, derivative_flag. Also require a checkbox during onboarding where partner accepts derivative redistribution terms.

ops-bot: Ticket OPS-8123 created: add artifact_checksum, origin_url, derivative_flag, sku_type fields to marketplace manifest. Assignee: ops-infra. ETA 2026-10-02.

sana: Actions: 1) @max upload addendum PDF + public blurb link (EOD). 2) @jules to prepare SKU mapping and entitlement table (due +2 days). 3) @sana to draft partner comms and embargo dates (due +3 days). Thanks everyone :white_check_mark:
